description: This file implements PWM signal generation logic, including setting duty cycles, handling cycle start, toggling PWM states, and managing hardware pin states. It defines classes and functions for precise PWM control in embedded firmware, with detailed control over signal timing, cycle management, and execution scheduling.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Class for managing a simple PWM with basic duty cycle control.

classes.name: PwmConfig
classes.description: Class encapsulating configuration and control logic for PWM cycles, including frequency, phase, and waveform handling.

methods.name: SimplePwm::setSimplePwmDutyCycle
methods.description: Sets the duty cycle of the PWM, adjusting mode accordingly.

methods.name: PwmConfig::setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the PWM frequency by adjusting the period in nanoseconds.

methods.name: PwmConfig::handleCycleStart
methods.description: Resets internal state at the beginning of a PWM cycle, invoking the cycle callback.

methods.name: PwmConfig::togglePwmState
methods.description: Main logic to toggle PWM signal state, schedule next toggle, and handle phase progression.

methods.name: timerCallback
methods.description: Static callback function to schedule PWM toggling based on configuration.

methods.name: copyPwmParameters
methods.description: Copies switch times and pin states into PWM configuration.

methods.name: PwmConfig::weComplexInit
methods.description: Initializes PWM configuration and starts the PWM timer cycle.

methods.name: startSimplePwm
methods.description: Initializes and starts a simple PWM instance with specified frequency and duty cycle.

methods.name: startSimplePwmExt
methods.description: Extended version of startSimplePwm that also initializes output pin.

methods.name: applyPinState
methods.description: Handles the actual hardware pin setting based on PWM state index.
